description: Retry funding a pending_funding negotiation's escrow from your wallet after a top-up. Returns the shortfall when the wallet still cannot cover it. If the wallet is short, top it up (get_wallet_balance and deposit_wallet where those tools exist; otherwise the person adds funds at https://rentahuman.ai/account/wallet), then call fund_negotiation. Idempotent once funded. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.
name: fund_negotiation
title: Fund negotiation
